استمطرت (form X)
# اِسْتَمْطَرْتُ (istamṭartu) /is.tam.tˤar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اِسْتَمْطَرْتَ (istamṭarta) /is.tam.tˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اِسْتَمْطَرْتِ (istamṭarti) /is.tam.tˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اِسْتَمْطَرَتْ (istamṭarat) /i
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
